let wrapAllSides = true
let campaignFrame = 'poster' // 'poster' or 'bleed'

function drawFullWrapFace(ctx, img, face) {
  const W = TEX_W
  const H = TEX_H
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H)

  if (campaignFrame === 'poster') {
    // Top Header: Clean off-white header with brand title
    const headerH = H * 0.16
    const bgHeader = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, headerH)
    bgHeader.addColorStop(0, '#f9f7f2')
    bgHeader.addColorStop(1, '#ebe6dc')
    ctx.fillStyle = bgHeader
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, headerH)

    // Top Brand Gold Glyph
    ctx.save()
    ctx.beginPath()
    const iconW = 44, iconH = 34
    const iconX = (W - iconW) / 2
    const iconY = headerH * 0.28
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#c49a38'
    ctx.lineWidth = 4
    ctx.strokeRect(iconX, iconY, iconW, iconH)
    ctx.stroke()

    // Header Text
    ctx.textAlign = 'center'
    ctx.font = '800 36px "Plus Jakarta Sans", sans-serif'
    ctx.letterSpacing = '6px'
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1f2c'
    ctx.fillText(brandHeaderText.toUpperCase(), W / 2, headerH * 0.72)

    ctx.font = '700 20px "Plus Jakarta Sans", monospace'
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(26, 31, 44, 0.6)'
    ctx.letterSpacing = '5px'
    ctx.fillText('STILL ARTISAN WATER · 500ML', W / 2, headerH * 0.88)
    ctx.restore()

    // Middle Artwork: Full bleed image photograph
    const bodyH = H * 0.63
    const bodyY = headerH

    // Cover crop image into body area
    drawImageCover(ctx, img, 0, bodyY, W, bodyH)

    // Bottom Banner: Navy luxury contact banner
    const footerY = bodyY + bodyH
    const footerH = H - footerY

    const bgFooter = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, footerY, 0, H)
    bgFooter.addColorStop(0, currentTheme.bgDark)
    bgFooter.addColorStop(1, '#050a12')
    ctx.fillStyle = bgFooter
    ctx.fillRect(0, footerY, W, footerH)

    // Gold separator line & circle badge (like in photo)
    ctx.save()
    const badgeY = footerY
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(0, badgeY)
    ctx.lineTo(W, badgeY)
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#c49a38'
    ctx.lineWidth = 6
    ctx.stroke()

    // Round badge "05" or "01"
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.arc(W / 2, badgeY, 44, 0, Math.PI * 2)
    ctx.fillStyle = currentTheme.bgDark
    ctx.fill()
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#c49a38'
    ctx.lineWidth = 4
    ctx.stroke()

    ctx.textAlign = 'center'
    ctx.font = '800 32px "Plus Jakarta Sans", sans-serif'
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff'
    ctx.fillText('05', W / 2, badgeY + 11)

    // Campaign Title
    ctx.font = '800 38px "Plus Jakarta Sans", sans-serif'
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff'
    ctx.letterSpacing = '2px'
    ctx.fillText(brandFooterText.toUpperCase(), W / 2, footerY + footerH * 0.42)

    // Subtitle tagline
    ctx.font = '700 24px "Plus Jakarta Sans", sans-serif'
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f7c61a'
    ctx.letterSpacing = '4px'
    ctx.fillText('YOUR BRAND IN REAL WORLD REACH', W / 2, footerY + footerH * 0.58)

    // Contact numbers & website
    ctx.font = '700 28px monospace'
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85)'
    ctx.letterSpacing = '2px'
    ctx.fillText(brandContactText, W / 2, footerY + footerH * 0.76)

    ctx.font = '600 22px monospace'
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)'
    ctx.fillText('WWW.SIPVERTISE.COM · SCAN TO CONNECT', W / 2, footerY + footerH * 0.88)
    ctx.restore()

  } else {
    // 100% FULL BLEED IMAGE (The uploaded photo covers the entire height of carton)
    drawImageCover(ctx, img, 0, 0, W, H)

    // Subtle dark gradient at top and bottom for readability
    const topG = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H * 0.15)
    topG.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)')
    topG.addColorStop(1, 'transparent')
    ctx.fillStyle = topG
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H * 0.15)

    const botG = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, H * 0.82, 0, H)
    botG.addColorStop(0, 'transparent')
    botG.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.85)')
    ctx.fillStyle = botG
    ctx.fillRect(0, H * 0.82, W, H * 0.18)

    // Minimal top & bottom branding
    ctx.save()
    ctx.font = '800 28px "Plus Jakarta Sans", sans-serif'
    ctx.letterSpacing = '4px'
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff'
    ctx.fillText(brandHeaderText, W * 0.08, H * 0.055)

    ctx.textAlign = 'center'
    ctx.font = '700 26px "Plus Jakarta Sans", monospace'
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff'
    ctx.fillText(brandContactText, W / 2, H * 0.94)
    ctx.restore()
  }

  // Draw QR stamp on back face or front bottom
  if (face === 'back' || (face === 'front' && campaignFrame === 'bleed')) {
    drawBrandQR(ctx, W, H)
  }
}

if (uploadedImage) {
    if (campaignFrame === 'poster') {
      // Header zone
      const headerH = H * 0.14
      const hGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, headerH)
      hGrad.addColorStop(0, '#f9f7f2')
      hGrad.addColorStop(1, '#ebe6dc')
      ctx.fillStyle = hGrad
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, headerH)

      ctx.save()
      ctx.textAlign = 'center'
      ctx.font = '800 52px "Plus Jakarta Sans", sans-serif'
      ctx.letterSpacing = '6px'
      ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1f2c'
      ctx.fillText(brandHeaderText.toUpperCase(), W / 2, headerH * 0.62)
      ctx.font = '600 28px monospace'
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(26,31,44,0.55)'
      ctx.letterSpacing = '4px'
      ctx.fillText('STILL ARTISAN WATER · 500ML', W / 2, headerH * 0.88)
      ctx.restore()

      // Body image
      const bodyH = H * 0.64
      drawImageCover(ctx, uploadedImage, 0, headerH, W, bodyH)

      // Footer
      const footerY = headerH + bodyH
      const footerH = H - footerY
      const fGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, footerY, 0, H)
      fGrad.addColorStop(0, currentTheme.bgDark)
      fGrad.addColorStop(1, '#050a12')
      ctx.fillStyle = fGrad
      ctx.fillRect(0, footerY, W, footerH)

      ctx.save()
      ctx.textAlign = 'center'
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.moveTo(0, footerY)
      ctx.lineTo(W, footerY)
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#c49a38'
      ctx.lineWidth = 6
      ctx.stroke()

      ctx.font = '800 48px "Plus Jakarta Sans", sans-serif'
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff'
      ctx.letterSpacing = '2px'
      ctx.fillText(brandFooterText.toUpperCase(), W / 2, footerY + footerH * 0.42)
      ctx.font = '700 30px "Plus Jakarta Sans", sans-serif'
      ctx.fillStyle = '#f7c61a'
      ctx.letterSpacing = '3px'
      ctx.fillText('YOUR BRAND IN REAL WORLD REACH', W / 2, footerY + footerH * 0.60)
      ctx.font = '700 28px monospace'
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.85)'
      ctx.letterSpacing = '2px'
      ctx.fillText(brandContactText, W / 2, footerY + footerH * 0.76)
      ctx.restore()
    } else {
      // Full bleed
      drawImageCover(ctx, uploadedImage, 0, 0, W, H)
      const topG = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H * 0.13)
      topG.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)')
      topG.addColorStop(1, 'transparent')
      ctx.fillStyle = topG; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H * 0.13)
      const botG = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, H * 0.83, 0, H)
      botG.addColorStop(0, 'transparent')
      botG.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.88)')
      ctx.fillStyle = botG; ctx.fillRect(0, H * 0.83, W, H * 0.17)
      ctx.save()
      ctx.font = '800 42px "Plus Jakarta Sans", sans-serif'
      ctx.letterSpacing = '5px'
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff'
      ctx.fillText(brandHeaderText, W * 0.07, H * 0.06)
      ctx.textAlign = 'center'
      ctx.font = '700 34px monospace'
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff'
      ctx.fillText(brandContactText, W / 2, H * 0.94)
      ctx.restore()
    }
  }
